subject: science

chapters.name: Matter in Our Surroundings
learning_outcomes: Define matter and its characteristics
Explain states of matter and interconversion
Understand effect of temperature and pressure on states
Describe evaporation and factors affecting it
key_concepts: States of matter: solid, liquid, gas
Change of state: melting, boiling, sublimation

chapters.name: Is Matter Around Us Pure?
learning_outcomes: Distinguish between mixtures and pure substances
Classify mixtures: homogeneous, heterogeneous
Understand solutions, suspensions, colloids
Explain separation techniques
key_concepts: Separation techniques: evaporation, centrifugation, chromatography, distillation

chapters.name: Atoms and Molecules
learning_outcomes: State laws of chemical combination
Understand Dalton's atomic theory
Define atomic mass, molecular mass, mole concept
Calculate formula unit mass and percentage composition
key_concepts: Laws: conservation of mass, definite proportions, multiple proportions

chapters.name: Structure of the Atom
learning_outcomes: Describe discovery of electron, proton, neutron
Compare Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr models
Understand atomic number, mass number, isotopes, isobars
Explain electronic configuration

chapters.name: The Fundamental Unit of Life
learning_outcomes: Describe cell as basic unit of life
Compare plant and animal cells
Explain cell organelles and their functions
Understand cell division: mitosis, meiosis
key_concepts: Cell organelles: nucleus, mitochondria, plastids, ER, Golgi, lysosomes, vacuoles

chapters.name: Tissues
learning_outcomes: Define tissue and its types in plants and animals
Explain plant tissues: meristematic, permanent
Explain animal tissues: epithelial, connective, muscular, nervous
key_concepts: Plant tissues: meristematic (apical, lateral, intercalary), permanent (simple, complex)
Animal tissues: epithelial (types), connective (types), muscular (types), nervous

chapters.name: Diversity in Living Organisms
learning_outcomes: Understand basis of classification
Explain hierarchy: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species
Describe five kingdom classification
Classify plants and animals into major groups
key_concepts: Five kingdoms: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia
Plant divisions: Thallophyta, Bryophyta, Pteridophyta, Gymnosperms, Angiosperms

chapters.name: Motion
learning_outcomes: Describe motion: distance, displacement, speed, velocity, acceleration
Interpret distance-time and velocity-time graphs
Derive equations of motion for uniform acceleration
Understand uniform circular motion
key_concepts: Equations of motion: v = u + at, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as

chapters.name: Force and Laws of Motion
learning_outcomes: State Newton's three laws of motion
Define inertia and momentum
Understand conservation of momentum
Apply F = ma and impulse-momentum theorem

chapters.name: Gravitation
learning_outcomes: State universal law of gravitation
Understand free fall and acceleration due to gravity
Distinguish mass and weight
Explain buoyancy and Archimedes' principle
key_concepts: Universal law of gravitation: F = Gm₁m₂/r²

chapters.name: Work and Energy
learning_outcomes: Define work, energy, power
Understand kinetic and potential energy
State law of conservation of energy
Calculate power and commercial unit of energy

chapters.name: Sound
learning_outcomes: Understand production and propagation of sound
Describe characteristics: frequency, amplitude, speed
Explain reflection of sound: echo, reverberation
Understand range of hearing, ultrasound applications
key_concepts: Speed of sound in different media

chapters.name: Why Do We Fall Ill?
learning_outcomes: Define health and disease
Classify diseases: acute, chronic, infectious, non-infectious
Understand pathogens and modes of transmission
Explain prevention and treatment principles
key_concepts: Infectious agents: bacteria, viruses, fungi, protozoa

chapters.name: Natural Resources
learning_outcomes: Understand Earth's resources: air, water, soil
Explain biogeochemical cycles: water, nitrogen, carbon, oxygen
Describe air, water, soil pollution and prevention
Understand ozone depletion and greenhouse effect
key_concepts: Resources on Earth: air, water, soil
Biogeochemical cycles: water cycle, nitrogen cycle, carbon cycle, oxygen cycle
Ozone layer depletion, greenhouse effect, global warming

chapters.name: Improvement in Food Resources
learning_outcomes: Understand crop variety improvement
Explain crop production management: nutrients, irrigation, cropping patterns
Describe crop protection management: pests, weeds, diseases
Understand animal husbandry: dairy, poultry, fish, beekeeping
key_concepts: Cropping patterns: mixed cropping, intercropping, crop rotation
Animal husbandry: cattle, poultry, fish, beekeeping
